999008199.text:
事の起こりは、ある日、流れ星が離島に落ちたこと。
その一週間後に、調査団は離島へと向かった

localizations.en: It all started when a shooting star fell on a remote island. One week later, an investigation team was sent to look into it.

999008199.text:
調査団は、なんの収穫も得られず、そして
ひどく調子を崩して帰還したとのことだったけど――

localizations.en: They supposedly returned empty-handed and in terrible condition, but—

999008199.text: 結果から言えば、それは嘘だったということだな

localizations.en: As it turns out, that was a lie.

999008199.text:
うん。あたしたちは、星が落ちたらしき場所を
見つけたよ。大きく地面が抉れてたんだ

localizations.en: Right. We found where the star seemed to have landed. There was a huge gouge in the ground.

999008199.text:
そのすぐ近くに、焚火の跡があったからね。
調査団は、多分そこまで辿り着いたんだよ

localizations.en: And we found traces of a campfire nearby. The investigation team must have made it that far.

999008199.text: で、その石を回収しようと作業してたってわけか

localizations.en: So they were trying to collect those stones, huh?

999008199.text:
私が調査団の倉庫から削ってきた石と、
ルトガーが拾った石は同じものみたいね。確かな証拠よ

localizations.en: The stone I took from the investigation team's storage and the one Rutger found are definitely the same. That's solid evidence.

999008199.text:
この石は状況的に、落ちた星の欠片。
それが、こんな騒ぎを引き起こしているなんて……

localizations.en: Given the circumstances, these stones must be fragments of that fallen star. To think they'd cause all this trouble...

999008199.text:
ルトガーは石に操られたじゃない？
ただの流れ星じゃなさそうよね

localizations.en: The stone was controlling Rutger, wasn't it? This is definitely no ordinary shooting star.

999008199.text:
し、神官長さんの様子を思い出すと……そっか。
あれは操られてたんですね

localizations.en: When I think about how the High Priest was acting... I see. He was being controlled too.

999008199.text: うん。フラミィに石を解析してもらったんだけど

localizations.en: Yeah. I had Flammi analyze the stone...

999008199.text:
簡単な解析ですが、石はマナと極めて類似した物質を
発信、または受信する性質を備えているようです

localizations.en: From my basic analysis, the stone appears to transmit or receive a substance remarkably similar to mana.

999008199.text:
マナのような物質……「青の領域」の粒子と同じ
ものなのかな？

localizations.en: A mana-like substance... Could it be the same as the particles in the blue zone?

999008199.text:
私やニーナみたいに、なぜか大丈夫な人もいる
みたいだけどね

localizations.en: Though it seems some people, like Nina and me, are somehow immune to it.

999008199.text:
そんな力で、調査団はいったい何をしようと
しているんだろう？

localizations.en: What could the investigation team be planning to do with such power?

999008199.text:
これは僕の推測だが、調査団はまず「青の領域」に
棲息する魔物で効果を確かめたんだろう

localizations.en: This is just my theory, but they probably first tested its effects on the monsters living in the blue zone.

999008199.text:
その中にツォルンフルクもいたんじゃない
だろうか？

localizations.en: I suspect Zornfluch was among them.

999008199.text:
で、欲に駆られて石を拾ったルトガーが、まんまと
魔物たちに交じって行動したがった、っと

localizations.en: And then Rutger, driven by greed, picked up a stone and ended up wanting to hang out with the monsters!

999008199.text: うるせぇな！

まぁまぁ。神官長は今、その石を使って作った
ブレスレットを国中に広めようとしてるんだよね

localizations.en: Now, now. The High Priest is currently trying to distribute bracelets made with these stones throughout the country.

999008199.text: すべての国民に着用を義務付けようとしてるんだって

localizations.en: I heard they're planning to make wearing them mandatory for all citizens.

999008199.text:
そんなことになったら、国が乗っ取られちゃうよ！
何が目的で、そんなこと……

localizations.en: If that happens, they'll take over the whole country! What could they possibly be trying to achieve...

999008199.text:
うーん。１つだけ言えるのは、神官長を操らせたのは
石を触らせた調査団の団長よね

localizations.en: Hmm. One thing's for sure—the investigation team's leader made the High Priest touch the stone to control him.

999008199.text: ブレスレットを作るのを提案したのも、団長だし？

localizations.en: And it was the leader who suggested making the bracelets too, right?

999008199.text:
恐らく団長って奴が、現場で一番最初に
石に触ったんだろうな

localizations.en: The leader was probably the first one to touch the stone at the site.

999008199.text:
団長は、石の意思ってヤツを真っ先に受信して、
忠実に動いてるんだろうぜ

localizations.en: The leader must have been the first to fall under the control of the stone... or should I say, under rock-solid control.

999008199.text: 「イシのイシ」って、上手いこと言ったつもり！？

localizations.en: Really? You're trying to make puns at a time like this!?

999008199.text:
いやいや待って。それだと石そのものが意思を
持ってるってことになっちゃうけど……

localizations.en: Hold on. That would mean the stone itself has a will of its own...

999008199.text: この世界には、意思を持つ物質が存在するの？

localizations.en: Are there materials in this world that possess consciousness?

999008199.text: そ、それは私たちも聞いたことが無いかも

localizations.en: W-we've never heard of anything like that...

999008199.text:
とすれば、団長を起点として考えた場合、
１つ疑問が残るんだが

localizations.en: If we focus on the leader's involvement, one question remains.

999008199.text:
団長が石の力を得て皆を操ろうとしたと
したとすると、彼が「青の領域」を作ったのだろうか？

localizations.en: If the leader gained the stone's power and is trying to control everyone, did they create the blue zone?

999008199.text:
んー、確かに。あの領域はなんで……
なんのために作ったんだろう？

localizations.en: Hmm, you're right. Why... what purpose does that zone serve?

999008199.text:
「青の領域」には謎が多すぎて、今のところは
考えても仕方ない気がするかな

localizations.en: There are too many mysteries surrounding the blue zone. I don't think we can figure it out right now.

999008199.text:
ともかく今の団長は石の司令塔みたいな状態で、
神官長すら操る力がある。そこだけ考えようよ

localizations.en: For now, let's focus on how the leader is like a command center for the stones, with enough power to control even the High Priest.

999008199.text:
最初に石に触ったからそうなったのか、
そういう特別な石があるのか分からないけど……

localizations.en: Whether it's because they were the first to touch the stones, or because they have some special stone...

999008199.text:
でも、団長はきっと、みんなを
操る司令塔となる石か何かを持ってるはずなんだ

localizations.en: The leader must have some kind of master stone that lets them control everyone.

999008199.text:
だからまずはそれをどうにかするのが
先決かなーって思うんだけど？

localizations.en: I think our first priority should be dealing with that. What do you think?

999008199.text: 賛成！　早速調査団の本部に乗り込みましょ！

localizations.en: Agreed! Let's storm the investigation team's headquarters!

999008199.text: いいかな、みんな？

ふふっ。あんなただ働きをさせた報いは
受けてもらわないといけないわよね

localizations.en: Hehe. They need to pay for making us work for free.

999008199.text:
待って待って！　ユミアたちは仲間と
合流できたわけだし……なのに協力してくれるの？

localizations.en: Wait, wait! You've all found your companions now... Are you sure you still want to help us?

999008199.text: もっちろんだよ！　困ってる人は放っておけないし！

localizations.en: Of course! We can't just ignore people in trouble!

999008199.text: レイニャたちも、助けていただきましたし

同じ調査団として、騒動の元となっているのを
見逃すことはできないからね

localizations.en: As fellow members of the research team, we can't turn a blind eye to what's causing all this chaos.

999008199.text: チッ……仕方ねえ。乗り掛かった舟だしな

localizations.en: Tch... Whatever. We're already in this deep.

999008199.text: これも何かの縁だし、最後まで協力させて

localizations.en: This must be fate. Let us help you until the end.

999008199.text: ありがとう！　心強いよ！

localizations.en: Thank you! That means so much to us!
